messages.subject: Project Beacon - any update on the disclosure schedule?
messages.plaintextBody: Sarah - separate to Harbor, are we any closer on the Project Beacon disclosure schedule? The Meadowbank team are chasing and we'd like to get that one to signing before the holidays. No rush on Harbor, that's well in hand. Thanks, Priya
